production.treatment: Zyra-owned runtime resolver, doctor, API/Web/release integration, manifest validation, first-task probe, and runtime provenance.

test.treatment: Zyra integration, release, restart, integrity, Web, and productization behavior tests.

runtime-assets/vendor-like.treatment: Upstream LoopX runtime source and resources; never counted as Zyra deep-internalization code.

adapter-only.treatment: Retired installer facade and compatibility diagnostics.

generated.treatment: Source manifests, duplicated packaged locks, and upstream generated lock content.

data.treatment: Upstream documentation/examples/data and small deterministic Zyra config updates; no training dataset or checkpoint.

mock/fixture.treatment: Upstream LoopX tests and fixtures, retained for audit but not used to claim Zyra production depth.

scripts.treatment: Deterministic source builder, runtime verifier, and cross-version upgrade harness.

docs.treatment: Review, evidence, and forward-state documentation are committed separately from the target implementation.
